newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon t-bill auction raises 354.5 bln pounds.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon t-bill auction raises 354.5 bln pounds.

text.p: Lebanon's weekly treasury bill issue of July 24 raised 354.5 billion Lebanese pounds, according to finance ministry results issued on Monday.
The previous issue raised 470.8 billion pounds.
The issue posted a nominal deficit of subscription against maturity of 33.9 billion pounds. It raised the following amounts (in billion of pounds, previous week in brackets):

The central bank said 20 percent of all competitive bids -- those made by Lebanese institutions -- were accepted up to the discount rate and yield for three-month bills and 65 percent for the six-month bills.

It also restricted the acceptance of non-competitive bids -- those made by private individuals and foreign investors -- for the shorter-term bills, approving 20 percent up to the discount rate and yield for three-month bills and 65 percent for six-month bills.
All competitive and non-competitive bids were approved for one-year and two-year bills.
The Lebanese pound closed at 1,537.75 to the dollar on Monday from 1,538.5 a week earlier and 1,567 a year ago.
